product.olivetti-snx-140-r.summary: The factory SNX 140 prepared for hot-swappable drives.
product.olivetti-snx-140-r.history: Olivetti sold the 140/R as the high-availability SNX 140 variant. The guide records that the SNX 160/RS replaced it in April 1995.
product.olivetti-snx-140-r.architecture: Drives could be replaced while the server was running. The R version combines the IRON case with the GO2044 SCSI RAID controller for RAID 1 or 5.
product.olivetti-snx-140-r.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-snx-140-r.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-snx-140-r.service-guide: Olivetti, SNX / NetStrada – Pocket Service Guide, ch. 1
